recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up in core FHIR is needed for FHIR-14407 unless a future modeling decision changes the preferred representation of action-type bindings.
issue_request: FHIR-14407 was a Published/Persuasive CDS change request raised against STU3 PlanDefinition. It said PlanDefinition.action.type was a Coding with a Required binding, contrary to FHIR modeling guidance, and asked that the element become a CodeableConcept with an Extensible binding.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied in SVN 13266, now git commit b17b8633b3a52671552e06efc12ee110e5a577ab, whose message explicitly names GF#14407 and GF#14408 and changes PlanDefinition and RequestGroup action.type to CodeableConcept with extensible bindings. That matches the Jira comment recording SVN 13266.
additional_context: PlanDefinition remains an active resource in source/fhir.ini, so source/plandefinition/structuredefinition-PlanDefinition.xml is in current build scope. The same historical commit also handled FHIR-14408 for RequestGroup; current fhir.ini maps RequestGroup to RequestOrchestration, and the combined branch already contains an audit commit for FHIR-14408. FHIR-15560 is a later duplicate of the same PlanDefinition concern. Zulip discussion from the creation date supports the Jira rationale, and no Confluence references or conflicting community records were found.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/plandefinition/structuredefinition-PlanDefinition.xml already defines PlanDefinition.action.type as CodeableConcept and binds it extensibly to http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/action-type.

related_jiras.note: RequestGroup.action.type was changed in the same historical commit; current RequestGroup maps to RequestOrchestration and FHIR-14408 is already represented on the combined branch.
Later PlanDefinition.action.type concern explicitly identified by Bryn Rhodes as a duplicate of FHIR-14407.
